applyTo: "src/{features,pages,template}/**/*.{tsx,ts,css}"

# Front End UI Guidelines
- Functional React 19 components with explicit prop interfaces.
- Use PrimeReact components (`DataTable`, `InputText`, `Button`, `Chart`) and React-Bootstrap layout grid (`Row`, `Col`, `Container`).
- Integrate React Hook Form (`useForm`, `Controller`) for all form fields.
- Prefer named exports over default exports.
